title: Booking / reservation sync failure (OTA / channel manager / PMS)
description: Reservations from the website or OTAs (Booking.com, Expedia, Agoda) are not appearing in the PMS, or the PMS and channel manager disagree.
problemDescription: Booking không hiện trên PMS. Reservation sync failed, OTA booking missing in PMS, channel manager error.
prerequisites: Employee can access the channel manager / PMS
expectedResult: Reservations appear correctly in the PMS and match the OTA.
failureCondition: After all steps reservations still do not sync or mismatch persists.
escalationCondition: Integration/credential fault suspected or steps exhausted without resolution.

steps.instruction: Confirm the scope: are ALL channels failing, or just one OTA?
Check the channel manager connection status and the PMS interface (e.g. interface service running). Restart the interface if red.
Check that OTA's mapping/credentials in the channel manager; re-authorize if expired.
Trigger a manual sync/pull for the affected channel. Did the reservation appear in the PMS?
Great — verify the guest details match the OTA and confirm with front desk.
